rules.quote: Must have completed an equivalent of a U.S. bachelor's degree from a recognized Indian university with at least 55% marks.
Must have at least three years' full-time (paid) professional work experience relevant to the proposed field of study by the application deadline;
Must not have another degree from a U.S. university or be enrolled in a U.S. degree program;

rules.value: Government of India / State Government employees
rules.quote: Employees of the Government of India and Indian State Governments are not eligible for any Fulbright-Nehru Fellowships.
Applications are invited in the following fields only:

amount.text: J-1 visa support, round-trip airfare, tuition and fees, living costs, accident and sickness coverage; no dependant support
amount.quote: funding for tuition and fees, living and related costs, and accident and sickness coverage per U.S. Government guidelines.
